race.description: Bj's Workwear Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: UMBUSI (8) has the strongest recent line after finishing fourth at Scone, beaten just under a length, despite beginning slowly as a well-supported favourite. The rise to 1280m is untried, but he also had to cover ground on debut and has still finished close up in both starts. Has the right profile third-up. VINTAGE BELL (7) was plain when sixth at Newcastle, yet he now comes out of provincial company and his Scone debut reads well enough, having finished between UMBUSI and VAGUELY RED. Improver. VAGUELY RED (9) had the excuses in that same Scone race, tightened on jumping, wide throughout and still beaten just under three lengths, with the first try around 1280m the main query. Bred to get this trip and further. TOKE (6) found the 900m too sharp first up with a battling fifth at Scone. Proven at the trip and can take a hand in the finish.
